fields.label: Order Qty (AB Qty)
fields.description: Defaults to the Sales Order Item's AB Qty when fetched via 'Create Dyeing Contract' - editable afterwards. Amount recalculates from Rate x this whenever it changes.

fields.label: SO Balance (AB Qty)
fields.description: AB Qty of this Sales Order row not yet assigned to any submitted Dyeing Contract, when this contract was created.

fields.label: Issued Qty (Pcs)
fields.description: Updated automatically by Issue Fabric - accumulates across multiple partial issues.

fields.label: Rolls (Issued)
fields.description: Updated automatically by Issue Fabric - accumulates across multiple partial issues.

fields.label: Weight (LBS) (Issued)
fields.description: 2026-09-28 - = (Issued Qty x TCS Finish Weight / 1000) x 2.2046. No longer manually entered/accumulated from Stock Entry.

fields.label: Received Qty (Pcs)
fields.description: Updated automatically when a Dyeing Receipt referencing this row is submitted.

fields.label: Rolls (Received)
fields.description: Updated automatically when a Dyeing Receipt referencing this row is submitted. Can never exceed Rolls (Issued) - enforced on Dyeing Receipt submit.

fields.label: Weight (LBS) (Received)
fields.description: 2026-09-28 - = (Received Qty x TCS Finish Weight / 1000) x 2.2046.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Agreed dyeing rate per unit with the supplier - entered manually.

fields.label: Sales Order Item Row
fields.description: Internal - the Sales Order Item row this was fetched from.

fields.label: Greige Batch
fields.description: Internal - fetched from the Sales Order Item's Greige Batch. Used to tag the Greige batch consumed on Issue Fabric.
